name: testbed_healthbar_bug
objective: Verify the health bar renders while HP is low. EXPECTED TO FAIL when the seeded defect is active.
description: The canary. The testbed hides the health bar when HP < 30; this scenario asserts it is visible. A QA tool that cannot find a known planted defect has not been shown to work. Run the testbed with --bug healthbar --hp 20 and this scenario must report FAIL with the divergence pointing at this step.

steps.name: healthbar_visible_while_low_hp
steps.description: Fails when the seeded defect is active. This is the intended, correct behaviour.
